race.description: Delaware @ Woodside Park F&M Mdn Plate
race.comment: SWIFT STAR (14) ran a strong race on debut at Caulfield Heath behind an impressive all-the-way winner, getting home strongly from back in the field and clearly closing off best. She should improve for that run and take a power of holding out. BLUE DREAM (11) is a filly by Justify on debut for the Grahame Begg yard. She's trialled well enough and the stable/connections are worth respecting. IFTIHAR (4) resumes. She showed ability last time in with a few placings in handy maidens and should go well here. BRUTELLI (3) is a mare by Brutal on debut for the Hawkes yard who debuts. She's jumped out fairly well and warrants respect. ALL TOO SINGLE (1) is going okay and is an each-way hope.
